body.summary: Addressed the review finding for TALLY-01 in local commit e696403e0f3c6872ad9e7d169d3c68163e855104 on work/tally-01. Standard input now uses an explicit UTF-8 StreamReader with byte-order-mark detection instead of the platform console encoding. Added CLI coverage for non-ASCII text without a final line break and a UTF-8 byte-order mark, and documented decoding in the README. Existing line, word and Unicode scalar counts and file-error handling are preserved. App and test projects compiled with warnings as errors, and all 34 direct CLI checks passed. The single required dotnet test invocation aborted before test execution because the sandbox denied VSTest's local socket; the full suite is not claimed to pass.
